question: Which of the following is NOT an important feature of the Industrial Policy of 1991?
solution:
The correct answer is No __**foreign trade policy.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• In 1991 India implemented a new economic policy.
 
• It implies the **foreign trade policy According to the WTO** to link the Indian economy to the international economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• New economic policy implements the standard reform as **LIbrelisation, privatization, and globalisation.**
 
• **Liberalization** consists the **free and easy licensing to the industrial sector**.
 
• **privatization** allows to handover of the **public sector industries to the private sector.**
 
• globalization was implemented to** erase the restriction about foreign economic relation**s.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 **New Economic Policy**

 
• In the context of the declining parameter of economic growth, the new economic policy was implemented in India in 1991.
 
 
• **Librelisation Reform under NEP 1991**

 
 
• Abolition of Industrial licensing.
 
• Contraction of Public Sector Undertakings.
 
• Removal of limitation on production.
 
• Financial sector regulation.
 
• Free play of market forces.
 
• Classification of Taxes.
 
 
 
• **Privatisation Reform under NEP 1991**
 
 
• Sale of Public sector Undertaking Industries to the private sector.
 
• Withdraw of Government ownership from mixed entrepreneurship.
 
 
 
• **Globalisation Reform under NEP 1991**
 
 
• Allows the foreign institutional investment.
 
• Freedom to import capital goods.
